( #{TDefectInfo.defectId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{TDefectInfo.defectLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{TDefectInfo.defectTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{TDefectInfo.defectType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{TDefectInfo.defectName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TDefectInfo.defectContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TDefectInfo.deviceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{TDefectInfo.cunstomId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TDefectInfo.instanceId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{TDefectInfo.stdMeteId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{TDefectInfo.confMode, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{TDefectInfo.isDefect, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{TDefectInfo.dealType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{TDefectInfo.dealInfo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TDefectInfo.dealPersonId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TDefectInfo.dealTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{TDefectInfo.ifDefectDisable, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{TDefectInfo.alarmSource, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{TDefectInfo.defectSubtype, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{TDefectInfo.deviceCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TDefectInfo.imagePath, jdbcType=String}, #{TDefectInfo.videoPath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TDefectInfo.value, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TDefectInfo.outRange, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TDefectInfo.linkMessage, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT a.defect_id, a.device_id, b.device_name, a.std_mete_id, k.mete_name, a.defect_time, a.deal_time, a.defect_type, e.dict_note as defect_type_name, a.conf_mode, f.dict_note as conf_mode_name, a.image_path, a.deal_info, a.deal_type, g.dict_note as deal_type_name, a.deal_person_id, h.user_name as deal_person_name, a.defect_content FROM t_defect_info a LEFT JOIN t_std_device b on a.device_id = b.device_id and a.cunstom_id = b.custom_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete k on a.std_mete_id = k.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business e on a.defect_type = e.dict_code LEFT JOIN t_dict_business f on a.conf_mode = f.dict_code LEFT JOIN t_dict_business g on a.deal_type = g.dict_code LEFT JOIN sys_user h on a.deal_person_id = h.user_id WHERE 1 = 1 and device_name like concat("%",#{deviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},"%") and k.mete_name like concat("%",#{meteName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},"%") and defect_type = #{defectModel, jdbcType=INTEGER} and conf_mode = #{confMode, jdbcType=INTEGER} and defect_time BETWEEN #{startTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND #{endTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} ORDER BY defect_time desc

SELECT a.timeNode, ifnull( b.count, 0 ) AS count FROM (select date_add(curdate(), interval(cast(help_topic_id as signed ) - 30) day) timeNode from mysql.help_topic where help_topic_id < day(last_day(curdate())) order by help_topic_id) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(defect_time) date, defect_time, count( 1 ) AS count FROM t_defect_info WHERE DATEDIFF( now( ), defect_time ) <= 31 GROUP BY date ) b ON a.timeNode = b.date order by a.timeNode

select dict_code as defect_type, dict_note as defect_type_name, (select COUNT(*) from t_defect_info WHERE defect_type = dict_code ) as c_ount from t_dict_business where dict_code in ( select dict_code from t_dict_business where col_name = 'defect_type' ) ORDER BY c_ount desc

SELECT a.processed as processed, b.untreated as unProcessed FROM ( (select count(conf_mode = 275 or null) as processed from t_defect_info where defect_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}) a, (select count(conf_mode = 276 or null) as untreated from t_defect_info where defect_time between #{startTime} and #{endTime}) b )

SELECT a.defect_id, a.device_id, b.device_name, a.std_mete_id, d.mete_name, a.defect_time, a.deal_time, a.defect_type, e.dict_note as defect_type_name, a.conf_mode, f.dict_note as conf_mode_name, a.image_path, a.deal_info, a.deal_type, g.dict_note as deal_type_name, a.deal_person_id, h.user_name as deal_person_name, a.defect_content FROM t_defect_info a LEFT JOIN t_std_device b on a.device_id = b.device_id and a.cunstom_id = b.custom_id LEFT JOIN t_std_mete d on a.std_mete_id = d.std_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business e on a.defect_type = e.dict_code LEFT JOIN t_dict_business f on a.conf_mode = f.dict_code LEFT JOIN t_dict_business g on a.deal_type = g.dict_code LEFT JOIN sys_user h on a.deal_person_id = h.user_id WHERE 1 = 1 and a.defect_id = #{defectId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT a.dict_note as defectLevlName, IFNULL(c.count,0) count FROM t_dict_business a left join (select count(1) as count,defect_level from t_defect_info GROUP BY defect_level ) c on a.dict_code = c.defect_level WHERE a.col_name='defect_level'

SELECT IFNULL( c.count, 0 ) AS count, b.dict_code as alarmLevel, b.dict_note as alarmLevelName FROM t_dict_business b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.alarm_level, count( a.alarm_level ) AS count FROM ( SELECT warn_level AS alarm_level, warn_id FROM t_warn_info UNION ALL ( SELECT alarm_level, robot_alarm_id FROM t_robot_alarm ) UNION ALL (SELECT alarm_level, camera_alarm_id FROM t_camera_alarm)) a GROUP BY a.alarm_level ) c ON c.alarm_level = b.dict_code WHERE b.col_name = 'alarm_level'

SELECT a.warn_time as warnTime, a.warn_content as warnContent, b.device_name as deviceName from t_warn_info a left join (select DISTINCT device_id,device_name from t_std_device) b on a.device_id = b.device_id where 1=1 and a.warn_level = #{alarmLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER} union all( SELECT c.alarm_time as warnTime, c.alarm_info as warnContent, d.robot_name as deviceName from t_robot_alarm c left join t_robot_info d on c.robot_id = d.robot_id where 1=1 and c.alarm_level = #{alarmLevel, jdbcType=INTEGER} ) order by warnTime desc LIMIT 20
